title: One row becomes one output
purpose: Match each reduction index, multiply, then accumulate in increasing index order.
caption: Match each reduction index, multiply, then accumulate in increasing index order. W [2,3] × x [3] = y [2]. row 0: 1×2 + 2×(-1) + 3×0.5 = 1.5. row 1: 4×2 + 5×(-1) + 6×0.5 = 6.
